svg.title: Diagram that shows six stages from seed-node preparation to a protected Azure Local management cluster.
svg.text: DISCONNECTED OPERATIONS / DEPLOYMENT ORDER
Start the Azure Local management cluster
Build the local control plane first. Keep tenant workloads on separate clusters.
Stage installation inputs
Prepare nodes, a compatible OS, OEM drivers, and Active Directory.
Set up trust on every node. On the seed node, stage the manifest, virtual
disks, Operations module, and management and ingress certificates.
Install the local control plane
Configure management and ingress networks, identity, certificates, and time.
Run Install-Appliance on the seed node. For air-gapped deployment, add
-disconnectMachineDeploy. Wait until installation finishes successfully.
Configure the local Azure environment
Run Add-AzLocalEnvironment on each node. Sign in as a subscription owner.
Confirm the local subscription and resource group before node initialization.
From a client, register providers and wait until they show Registered.
Initialize the nodes
Initialize the seed node first, then the remaining nodes.
Run Invoke-AzStackHciArcInitialization with -Cloud Azure.local.
Use a TargetSolutionVersion compatible with the appliance.
Form the management cluster
Pre-create the vault in the nodes' resource group and assign required roles.
Wait about five minutes for permissions. Retry validation if needed.
Deploy via the local portal as root operator or subscription owner.
Protect and register the deployment
Save BitLocker keys and exported Host Guardian Service certificates externally.
Complete self-attestation, limit operator access, and use policy to keep
tenant workloads off the management cluster.
Keep these safeguards in place
During cluster creation
The appliance becomes a clustered VM.
Keep the thinly provisioned 2-TB
infrastructure volume intact.
Plan for control-plane interruptions
during node reboots and updates.
Restore before deployment
Install an appliance matching the
backup version on the seed node.
Restore its state before forming
the replacement management cluster.
